column1: # Outcomes of unreadable words of detjob in an event row (the root of a row of the family events-unit; schema detjob-events.schema.json, V/05.3 N1.3, V/05.4 N1.2); the path is from the row. A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.

column3: does not judge the row: serves it by the door /events as read, the subsystem's fields as they are (P/06.4 N1.3; the event log contract line)

the subsystem's words not in the writer's form: not read, rather than absent — the row matches no trigger whose match names such a field (the comparison is strict, without coercion); not a refusal — the row goes to the window and the cursor like any other
pass of tick not in the writer's form: a trigger with match on «pass» does not match ("3" ≠ 3), the other fields of the row are compared
partial of scan.partial not in the writer's form: a trigger with match on «partial» does not match, the other fields are compared
waited of scan.partial not in the writer's form: a trigger with match on «waited» does not match, the other fields are compared
